descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you highly organised and process-driven? Do you have a strong attention to detail even when managing multiple priorities? Are you curious about how technology and innovation can enhance HR services?

As an HR Operations Intern for Italy, your responsibilities will include:

• Handling basic life-cycle events (i.e. OU changes, FTE changes)
• Managing employee absences and related documentation
• Processing and archiving HR documents
• Resolving basic employees inquiries
• Handling sensitive documents with discretion and professionalism
